main:1.text: S.S.D.D. (Same Shit, Different Day) is the first mission of Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 2 and Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 2 Campaign Remastered. It serves as a tutorial to teach players basic gameplay mechanics and controls. The level starts with PFC. Joseph Allen and Sgt.

main:2.text: Team Player is the second mission of Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 2 and Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 2 Campaign Remastered. With BCT-One trapped in the OpFor-occupied town, the U.S Army Rangers mobilize to rescue the stranded unit. After calling in an airstrike, the Rangers move into the city to mop up any present OpFor and secure BCT-One.

main:4.text: No Russian is the fourth mission of Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 2 and Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 2 Campaign Remastered. Taking place in Zakhaev International Airport, the controversial mission saw the player take part in a massacre of civilians in a false flag operation. The events of "No Russian" played a major role in starting World War III.

main:6.text: Wolverines! is the sixth campaign mission of Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 2 and Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 2 Campaign Remastered. The mission marks the beginning of Act 2 in the campaign. Although the Task Force 141 successfully recovered the ACS module, they were too late.

main:7.text: The Hornet's Nest is the seventh mission of Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 2 and Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 2 Campaign Remastered. Following the capture and interrogation of Alejandro Rojas, US forces have been banned from entering Brazilian airspace due to the destruction, forcing Captain MacTavish to call for outside help from Nikolai. The player controls Sgt.

main:9.page: The Only Easy Day... Was Yesterday
main:9.text: The Only Easy Day... Was Yesterday is the ninth mission of Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 2 and Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 2 Campaign Remastered. The player controls Gary "Roach" Sanderson. The objective of the mission is to eliminate hostiles and rescue three rooms full of hostages on an oil rig being used as a SAM site in order to allow Task Force 141 to infiltrate The Gulag and extract Prisoner 627.

main:11.text: Of Their Own Accord is the eleventh campaign mission in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 2 and Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 2 Campaign Remastered. It is the final mission in Act 2. Elements of the US Army, including the 75th Ranger Regiment are recuperating in an evacuation center, which is beneath the Washington Monument in Washington, D.C.

main:13.text: Second Sun is the thirteenth campaign mission of Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 2 and Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 2 Campaign Remastered. Continuing off of the action in "Of Their Own Accord", Pvt. Ramirez and his team make their last stand around the crashed helicopter they had been previously riding on.

main:14.text: Whiskey Hotel (White House) is the fourteenth mission of Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 2 and Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 2 Campaign Remastered. This level is the final mission where James Ramirez is playable, and the final appearance of Ramirez, Sgt. Foley and Cpl. Dunn in the series. The level continues from "Second Sun".

main:15.text: Loose Ends is the fifteenth mission of Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 2 and Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 2 Campaign Remastered. In this mission, Simon "Ghost" Riley, Gary "Roach" Sanderson, and other members of Task Force 141 infiltrate Makarov's safehouse where he is suspected to be located, but are met with a jarring surprise.

main:16.text: The Enemy of My Enemy is the sixteenth mission of Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 2 and Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 2 Campaign Remastered, during which the player controls Captain John "Soap" MacTavish during the battle between Shadow Company and Inner Circle in the airplane boneyard. At the Afghan boneyard, Soap continues his attempts to contact Ghost and Roach to no avail.

main:17.text: Just Like Old Times is the seventeenth and penultimate mission of Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 2 and Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 2 Campaign Remastered. With most of Task Force 141 eliminated and nearly out of allies that they can trust. Price and Soap, now labeled as war criminals and wanted fugitives, resolve there is nothing left to do but neutralize General Shepherd.
